title: Escalate the capture-queue nudge on settlements only, not on bookkeeping rows
action: The capture-queue nudge and the close door both thresholded on every queued stub. The queue also carries touches-sweep citation rows and promote pointers, which are not settlements and are usually not actionable by the session reading the message. Measured on this repo: 20 sweep + 8 promote + 6 settlements — so the blocker said 'flush before new work' about work the reader could not do, every session. Narrow the escalation to settlements in both places; keep every row queued, listed and flushable; name the bookkeeping count in the message so nothing looks dropped.
verify: cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml session_close && cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml drivers
acceptance: Bookkeeping rows never escalate the nudge or the door; settlements still escalate on their own count and age; the bookkeeping count is still named; both frozen under-threshold wordings stay byte-identical; the session_close and drivers suites are green.

truths: Bookkeeping rows (touches-sweep, promote) never escalate the nudge or the close door, however many are queued.
Settlements still escalate on their own count and on their own oldest age.
The bookkeeping count is still named in the nudge, so no row looks dropped.
Every row stays queued, listed and flushable — nothing leaves the queue.
Both frozen under-threshold wordings stay byte-identical to their pinned form.
The session_close and drivers suites are green.
